name: standalone
description: Compatibility profile for a standalone, single-world Screeps server (for example OpenScreeps) that the official web client and community tools can use as a private server. It selects official operations (`required`), documents why the rest are not provided (`excluded`), adds the private-server protocol operations the official client uses only when `options.official` is false (`additions`), and records precise standalone differences (`adaptations`, `overrides`). Official schemas are reused unchanged unless an override with `x-profile-reason` says otherwise.

info.title: Screeps standalone server HTTP API
info.summary: Official Screeps World HTTP contract composed with the standalone compatibility profile
info.description: Operations a standalone single-world Screeps server provides for the official web client and community tools. Composed from the official Screeps World contract and the standalone compatibility profile; each operation's `x-profile` states whether it is an unchanged official operation (`required`), an official operation with documented standalone differences (`adapted`), a private-server protocol operation (`addition`) or a server-specific extension (`extension`). One world is served: `shard` values are accepted for official-client compatibility and ignored. Logical failures arrive as `{error}` usually with HTTP 200; never infer success from the status code.

servers.description: Standalone server; configure host and port for your deployment.

host.description: Standalone server hostname or IP address.

transport.reason: The official web client sends `X-Server-Password` on every request when `options.official` is false and a server password is configured (Auth request interceptor in build.min.js), so password-protected standalone servers check it on API and room-history requests.

excluded.adminEarlyAccessList: Internal screeps.com staff tool for the hosted early-access campaign; a standalone server has no hosted applicant list.
excluded.adminEarlyAccessSend: Internal screeps.com staff tool that e-mails hosted early-access invitations; no hosted mail campaign on a standalone server.
excluded.adminTimelineStats: Internal screeps.com staff statistics for hosted shard infrastructure; standalone administration is outside the official contract (server-specific admin API).
excluded.arenaActivate: Arena is a hosted screeps.com game mode (dedicated `arena*` rooms, seasons and leaderboards run by screeps.com); a standalone single world has no Arena matchmaking and no Arena activation codes to redeem.
excluded.arenaFindInitRoom: Arena is a hosted screeps.com game mode (dedicated `arena*` rooms, seasons and leaderboards run by screeps.com); a standalone single world has no Arena matchmaking and no Arena room to assign.
excluded.arenaOrderOffer: Arena is a hosted screeps.com game mode (dedicated `arena*` rooms, seasons and leaderboards run by screeps.com); a standalone single world has no Arena matchmaking; the offer exposes a Steam key sold by screeps.com, a hosted payment product.
excluded.arenaOrderPurchase: Arena is a hosted screeps.com game mode (dedicated `arena*` rooms, seasons and leaderboards run by screeps.com); a standalone single world has no Arena matchmaking; purchasing Arena access is a screeps.com payment flow.
excluded.arenaStatus: Arena is a hosted screeps.com game mode (dedicated `arena*` rooms, seasons and leaderboards run by screeps.com); a standalone single world has no Arena matchmaking, so there is no Arena participation status.
excluded.arenaStatusUpdate: Arena is a hosted screeps.com game mode (dedicated `arena*` rooms, seasons and leaderboards run by screeps.com); a standalone single world has no Arena matchmaking and no Arena activation or respawn state.
excluded.authGithub: GitHub OAuth popup sign-in/linking via the screeps.com GitHub OAuth application and callback; standalone accounts sign in with username/e-mail + password (`POST /api/auth/signin`) or a Steam ticket (`POST /api/auth/steam-ticket`).
excluded.authGithubCheckRepoScope: Checks the scope of a GitHub OAuth authorization; only meaningful with the hosted GitHub OAuth link, which standalone servers do not provide.
excluded.authQueryToken: Inspects screeps.com account auth tokens (full vs restricted endpoint/WebSocket permissions); a standalone server has no API auth-token management and issues only short-lived full-access session tokens.
excluded.authSteam: Steam OpenID web popup flow bound to screeps.com; standalone servers authenticate Steam users with `POST /api/auth/steam-ticket` (authSteamTicket) instead.
excluded.gameFinish: Ends a hosted game-mode session in a room (the client's local counterpart marks the game info `finished`, as used by survival/custom modes); a persistent single world has no finishable session and no standalone implementation serves it.
excluded.gameHistoryShare: Hosted replay sharing service: it mints `screeps.com/s/<code>` short links, which only screeps.com can resolve.
excluded.gameShardsInfo: Multi-shard directory of screeps.com (per-shard CPU limits, users, tick statistics). A standalone server runs one world; the official client calls it only on its shards pages and, behind `options.official`, for the shard CPU-limit warning before first-spawn placement.
excluded.gameShardsTick: Multi-shard routing: the official client requests `game/shards/tick` only when `options.official` is true; standalone servers provide the private-server `gameTick` addition (`GET /api/game/tick`) instead.
excluded.platformExperimentalNukes: Experimental screeps.com multi-shard nuke analytics; not used by the official client and not part of the private-server protocol (backend-local has no such route).
excluded.platformExperimentalPvp: Experimental screeps.com multi-shard combat analytics; not used by the official client and not part of the private-server protocol (backend-local has no such route).
excluded.platformOfficialRoomHistory: Static history host of screeps.com (`HISTORY_URL/<shard>/<room>/<tick>.json`). The official client uses it only when `options.official` is true; standalone servers provide the `/room-history` addition instead.
excluded.platformServersLike: Likes in the screeps.com-curated community server directory, authenticated by Steam tickets; a standalone server is an entry in that directory, not a provider of it.
excluded.platformServersList: Hosted directory of community servers curated by screeps.com; a standalone server is an entry in that directory, not a provider of it.
excluded.platformServersUnlike: Likes in the screeps.com-curated community server directory, authenticated by Steam tickets; a standalone server is an entry in that directory, not a provider of it.
excluded.powerCreepsPromo: Time-limited screeps.com Global Power Level promotion (`CONFIG.OFFER_POWER_LEVEL_PROMO_END_TIME`); a standalone server runs no hosted offers.
excluded.registerChangePassword: Completes e-mail password recovery with an e-mailed token; requires hosted mail delivery and recovery tokens. Standalone passwords are set by the signed-in player (`POST /api/user/password`) or the server administrator.
excluded.registerConfirm: E-mail address verification link; requires hosted mail delivery.
excluded.registerRecover: Sends a password recovery e-mail; requires hosted mail delivery.
excluded.registerSubmit: Hosted registration flow (e-mail + reCAPTCHA with e-mail confirmation); standalone accounts are created through Steam sign-in or server administration.
excluded.replaysAdd: Hosted screeps.com replay sharing service for offline Survival simulations; replay storage and share secrets are not part of a standalone world.
excluded.replaysHistoryShare: Hosted screeps.com history-share links (`screeps.com/s/<code>`); the official client resolves them only on official servers, and private servers serve history through the `/room-history` addition instead.
excluded.replaysHistoryShareChunk: Official-only branch: the official client requests it only when `options.official` is true and a share code is present; with `options.official` false it reads `/room-history?room=&time=` (platform profile addition).
excluded.replaysList: Hosted screeps.com replay sharing service; a standalone world stores no uploaded simulation replays.
excluded.scoreboardList: Hosted Seasonal World game mode scoreboard; a standalone server runs a single persistent world.
excluded.seasonsAccessGrant: Granting Seasonal World access consumes Access Keys, a hosted screeps.com purchasable resource; no standalone equivalent.
excluded.seasonsAccessGranted: Seasonal World access is a hosted screeps.com competition gated by Access Keys; a standalone server is its own world with no seasonal access control.
excluded.seasonsCurrent: Hosted Seasonal World competitions; a standalone server runs a single persistent world.
excluded.seasonsCurrentLastPost: The Season Chronicle is editorial content of the hosted screeps.com Seasonal World (enabled by the `season-chronicle` feature); a standalone server has no Chronicle.
excluded.seasonsList: Hosted Seasonal World competitions; a standalone server runs a single persistent world.
excluded.seasonsUserRanks: Final ranks of hosted screeps.com Seasonal World competitions; a standalone server runs no Seasonal World competitions.

excluded.storeSteamCatalog: Steam item-shop catalog of screeps.com packages (payments); a standalone server sells nothing.
excluded.storeSteamInventory: Steam inventory integration of the screeps.com Steam app (items minted by screeps.com); no standalone equivalent.

excluded.storeSteamPullResources: Transfers Steam items into screeps.com account resources; requires the hosted economy and Steam item server.

excluded.storeSteamPushResources: Transfers screeps.com account resources (Access Keys, CPU unlocks, pixels) to Steam items; requires the hosted economy and Steam item server.
excluded.storeXsollaCancelSubscription: Xsolla CPU subscription billing of screeps.com (payments/subscriptions); a standalone server has no paid subscriptions.
excluded.storeXsollaCatalog: Xsolla item-shop catalog of screeps.com packages (payments); a standalone server sells nothing.
excluded.storeXsollaCoupon: Redeems screeps.com Xsolla coupons for paid CPU subscription days or CPU Credits (payments/subscriptions); no standalone equivalent.
excluded.storeXsollaToken: Creates an Xsolla Pay Station payment session for screeps.com purchases (payments); a standalone server sells nothing.
excluded.storeXsollaUser: Reads the screeps.com Xsolla CPU subscription (payments/subscriptions); a standalone server has no paid subscriptions.
excluded.supportReportProblem: Creates a screeps.com Zendesk support ticket; hosted support service.
excluded.supportSsoJwt: Zendesk single sign-on for the screeps.com forums/support desk; hosted service (also gated on an active subscription).
excluded.survivalActiveGame: Survival is a hosted screeps.com game mode that spawns per-player `survival_<id>` game rooms with invader waves; a standalone single world does not host Survival games.
excluded.survivalCreate: Survival is a hosted screeps.com game mode that spawns per-player `survival_<id>` game rooms with invader waves; a standalone single world does not host Survival games.
excluded.survivalGame: Survival is a hosted screeps.com game mode that spawns per-player `survival_<id>` game rooms with invader waves; a standalone single world does not host Survival games.
excluded.survivalReplay: Survival is a hosted screeps.com game mode that spawns per-player `survival_<id>` game rooms with invader waves; a standalone single world does not host Survival games, and Survival replays are stored by the hosted replay service.
excluded.userActivateCpuUnlocks: Consumes purchased CPU unlock items (hosted payments/inventory); a standalone server sets CPU limits administratively.
excluded.userActivatePtr: Public Test Realm (PTR) CPU unlock; a standalone server has no PTR.
excluded.userActivateShardAccess: Spends access keys for restricted screeps.com shards; multi-shard access does not exist on a single-world server.
excluded.userAuthTokenCreate: Persistent API auth-token management is a hosted screeps.com service (per-token permissions and rate limits); standalone servers issue session tokens through `POST /api/auth/signin`, and community tools authenticate to unofficial servers with credentials only.
excluded.userAuthTokenDelete: Persistent API auth-token management is a hosted screeps.com service (per-token permissions and rate limits); standalone servers issue session tokens through `POST /api/auth/signin`, and community tools authenticate to unofficial servers with credentials only.
excluded.userAuthTokenList: Persistent API auth-token management is a hosted screeps.com service (per-token permissions and rate limits); standalone servers issue session tokens through `POST /api/auth/signin`, and community tools authenticate to unofficial servers with credentials only.
excluded.userConvertCreditsSubscription: Converts credits into a paid screeps.com subscription; hosted payments/subscriptions.
excluded.userCpuLimitSet: Credits-charged CPU limit changes tied to the hosted subscription/credits economy; a standalone server sets CPU limits administratively.
excluded.userCpuShardsSet: Multi-shard CPU allocation; a standalone server runs a single world whose CPU is not split across shards.
excluded.userDecorationsActivate: Hosted pixel/decoration economy (pixelization, conversion and activation of owned decorations); a standalone server has no decoration inventory.
excluded.userDecorationsConvert: Hosted pixel/decoration economy (pixelization, conversion and activation of owned decorations); a standalone server has no decoration inventory.
excluded.userDecorationsDeactivate: Hosted pixel/decoration economy (pixelization, conversion and activation of owned decorations); a standalone server has no decoration inventory.
excluded.userDecorationsPixelize: Hosted pixel/decoration economy (pixelization, conversion and activation of owned decorations); a standalone server has no decoration inventory.
excluded.userEarlyPreviewActivate: Hosted World launch activation codes; a standalone world has no early-preview gate.
excluded.userEarlyPreviewRequest: Applies for the hosted early-preview program; no such program on a standalone server.
excluded.userFindShared: `branch: official` alternative: the official client calls `user/find-shared` only when `options.official`; on private servers the replay viewer uses `GET /api/user/find` (userFind, required).
excluded.userGithubRepoSet: GitHub code synchronization runs on screeps.com infrastructure via the hosted GitHub OAuth link; not available without it.
excluded.userGithubRepos: Lists repositories through the hosted GitHub OAuth link; not available without it.
excluded.userIvmSet: Selects between screeps.com's isolated and shared legacy VM runtime pools; a standalone server runs player code in its single operator-configured runtime.
excluded.userNoRateLimit: reCAPTCHA-gated reset of hosted per-token API rate limits; standalone servers have no persistent API tokens or reCAPTCHA.
excluded.userUnlinkGithub: Removes the hosted GitHub OAuth identity link, which standalone servers do not create.
excluded.userUnlinkSteam: Part of the hosted web identity-linking flow (`GET /api/auth/steam` popup); on a standalone server the Steam identity is the account created by `POST /api/auth/steam-ticket` and is managed by the administrator.

adaptations.authMe: Standalone accounts carry Steam ownership as one boolean flag and profile-link visibility as a boolean, and `steam` is an empty object when no Steam account is linked (override: AuthSteamAccount).
adaptations.gameCreateInvader: The standalone success body carries the inserted invader creep document next to `ok`.
adaptations.gameMapStats: Standalone rankings for `<stat><interval>` are complete per-player arrays of `{user, value}` sorted descending instead of the single ranking entry documented for screeps.com.
adaptations.gameRoomDecorations: No hosted decoration inventory: the decoration list is always empty and is served without authentication.
adaptations.leaderboardList: Standalone leaderboard user entries additionally carry the users' lifetime control points `gcl` (override: LeaderboardUser).
adaptations.marketMyOrders: Single world: the caller's orders are returned as a flat `list` instead of being grouped by shard under `shards`; the official client accepts `list` when `shards` is absent.
adaptations.platformSteamNews: A standalone server has no screeps.com news backend and relays the public Valve news feed instead; when that upstream is unavailable it reports HTTP 502 rather than inventing an empty feed.
adaptations.powerCreepsCreate: The standalone success body carries a copy of the created power creep record next to `ok`.
adaptations.registerSetUsername: Standalone success bodies are exactly `{ok: 1}` without database-driver write metadata (override: UserDbWriteResponse).
adaptations.userBadgeSet: Standalone success bodies are exactly `{ok: 1}` without database-driver write metadata (override: UserDbWriteResponse).
adaptations.userConsole: The standalone console queue returns exactly `{ok: 1}` without a database-driver insert echo (override: UserConsoleQueuedResponse).
adaptations.userDecorationsInventory: No hosted pixel/decoration economy on a standalone server: the inventory is always an empty list.
adaptations.userDecorationsThemes: No hosted pixel/decoration economy on a standalone server: the theme list is always empty.
adaptations.userEmailSet: Standalone success bodies are exactly `{ok: 1}` without database-driver write metadata (override: UserDbWriteResponse).
adaptations.userMemorySet: Standalone Memory writes return exactly `{ok: 1}` without a database-driver insert echo (override: UserConsoleQueuedResponse).
adaptations.userMessagesMarkRead: Standalone success bodies are exactly `{ok: 1}` without internal publish/update results (override: UserMessagesMarkReadResponse).
adaptations.userMoneyHistory: Standalone market money-log entries additionally carry the related order id and counterparty (override: UserMoneyHistoryMarketInfo).
adaptations.userNotifyPrefsSet: Standalone success bodies are exactly `{ok: 1}` without database-driver write metadata (override: UserDbWriteResponse).
adaptations.userOverview: Single world: statistics are returned flat (`rooms`, `stats`, `statsMax`, `totals`, `gametimes`) instead of grouped under `shards`; the official web client accepts this shape by wrapping the body as one pseudo-shard (`t.shards || (t.shards = {shard0: t})`).
adaptations.userRooms: Single world: owned rooms are returned as a flat `rooms` array instead of grouped under `shards`; the official web client maps a response without `shards` to one pseudo-shard (`e.shards || {shard0: e.rooms}`).
adaptations.userSetSteamVisible: Standalone success bodies are exactly `{ok: 1}` without database-driver write metadata (override: UserDbWriteResponse).
adaptations.userWorldStartRoom: Single world: the start room is always a plain room name without a `shard/` prefix (the official web client then falls back to its default shard).

additions.gameTick: The official web client requests `GET /api/game/tick` for the room renderer's tick duration whenever `options.official` is false (screeps.com uses `game/shards/tick`), so every standalone server must serve it.
additions.platformRoomHistory: The official web client fetches room history from `/room-history?room=&time=` whenever `options.official` is false (private-server branch), so every standalone server must serve it.

notes.authMe: Returns the private-server projection only (`_id`, `email`, `emailDirty`, `username`, `cpu`, `badge`, `password`, `lastRespawnDate`, `notifyPrefs`, `gcl`, `lastChargeTime`, `blocked`, `customBadge`, `power`, `money`, `steam`, `powerExperimentations`, `powerExperimentationTime`); never `cpuShard`, `cpuShardUpdatedTime`, `resources`, SSO links or legacy fields. `steam` is an empty object when no Steam account is linked. Token may be sent as `X-Token`, `Authorization: Bearer`, or `?token=`; each authenticated call issues a fresh token in the `X-Token` response header (default lifetime 60 s).
notes.authSignin: Primary authentication method of a standalone server. `email` accepts an e-mail address or a username (looked up case-insensitively unless it contains `@`); `recaptcha` and `steamTicket` are ignored. Passwords (8-1024 characters when set) are verified as scrypt hashes in constant time (unknown accounts still hash a dummy); every failure answers HTTP 401 `unauthorized`, and accounts without a configured password cannot sign in. Tokens are 64 lowercase hex characters, valid for `tokenLifetimeMs` (60 s default) and refreshed through the `X-Token` response header of authenticated calls.
notes.authSteamTicket: Authentication runs outside the world lock. Web API mode verifies tickets with Valve's AuthenticateUserTicket for app 464350 using an operator key. Opt-in native mode verifies encrypted app tickets with Greenworks and requires useNativeAuth to be true; platformVersion advertises the active mode. An unconfigured or mismatched scheme answers authentication method is not supported. Native mode retains the original published symmetric-key trust model and is not recommended for untrusted players. New accounts get 100 CPU, a default code branch and empty Memory.
notes.gameAddGlobalIntent: Successive calls append to the caller's pending global intent lists, which the next tick merges into the caller's script intents. `generatePixel`, `unlockCpu` and `activateAccess` are dropped (only the player runtime may record them).
notes.gameAddObjectIntent: Additionally requires `_id` (`invalid object`), requires the object to be in `room` (`invalid object`) and owned by the caller or, if unowned, in a room whose controller the caller owns (`not owner`), and rejects payload shapes the processor cannot handle (`invalid params`). An array `intent` is accepted only when `_id` is `room`; room-level list intents must be arrays of objects whose `roomName` equals `room`.
notes.gameChangeFlagColor: Without `room` nothing is saved and the call still succeeds; an empty flag document is created if the caller had none in that room. The success body is exactly `{ok: 1}`.
notes.gameCreateConstruction: The success body is `{ok: 1, _id}` without the MongoDB insert-result fields.
notes.gameCreateFlag: The success body is exactly `{ok: 1}` (no MongoDB `result`).
notes.gameCreateInvader: An unknown `size`/`type` or a position outside 0..49 is rejected with `invalid params`.
notes.gameMapStats: `rooms` must be an array and `statName` a string ending in digits (`invalid params` otherwise). Rankings are computed from per-minute statistics as arrays of `{user, value}` sorted descending; only users that still exist are counted. Non-string room names and rooms without a room document are ignored; `own.user` is omitted for an invader core without a user.
notes.gamePlaceSpawn: Placing the first spawn does not change CPU settings.
notes.gameRemoveFlag: A missing `room` succeeds without effect; an empty flag document is created when none existed. The success body is exactly `{ok: 1}`.
notes.gameRoomDecorations: No decoration inventory exists: the response is always `{ok: 1, decorations: []}`, also without authentication.
notes.gameRoomOverview: Requires `room` (`invalid room`), falls back to an 8-minute interval for unsupported values (`invalid params` for malformed input), sums every player's statistics in the room and reports every stat in `totals`, including zeros.
notes.gameRooms: A non-array `rooms` is rejected with `invalid params`; repeated names are deduplicated.
notes.gameSetNotifyWhenAttacked: An unknown object yields `invalid object`. The success body is exactly `{ok: 1}`.
notes.gameTick: Until two ticks have completed the configured tick duration is reported.
notes.gameWorldSize: Width and height are one square size computed from the room documents (0 for an empty world).
notes.leaderboardFind: Usernames are matched case-insensitively; unknown users yield `user not found`. `mode` is required (`invalid params` when omitted); other modes return empty results. `list` is ordered newest season first.
notes.leaderboardList: Clamps `limit` to 1-20 (default 10), treats invalid `offset` as 0, defaults `season` to the current UTC month and rejects malformed seasons or a missing `mode` with `invalid params`; other modes return empty results. Listed users also carry `gcl`.
notes.leaderboardSeasons: Lists every month with recorded scores plus the current month.
notes.marketMyOrders: Orders of the single world are returned as a flat `list` instead of per-shard `shards`; the official client accepts `list` when `shards` is absent.
notes.marketOrders: Without `resourceType` every active order is returned.
notes.marketStats: Without `resourceType` the history of every resource is returned.
notes.platformActivePromotion: No hosted item shop: the response is `{ok: 1}` without promotion fields.
notes.platformRoomHistory: `time` must identify a retained chunk base; at most `historyChunkSize` frames are returned and a missing chunk yields HTTP 404.
notes.platformSteamNews: Relays Valve ISteamNews/GetNewsForApp for the Screeps app (one item), cached for five minutes with concurrent requests coalesced.
notes.platformVersion: Standalone servers serve one world: `serverData.shards` and official hosted `features` (seasons, decorations, inventory) may be absent, in which case the official client falls back to its market/auth feature set.
notes.powerCreepsCreate: The success body is `{ok: 1, ...creep}`: a copy of the new record (`level: 0`, `hitsMax: 1000`, `storeCapacity: 100`, `spawnCooldownTime: 0`, `powers: {}`).
notes.powerCreepsUpgrade: Non-integer levels are also rejected with `invalid value for power <id>`.
notes.registerSetUsername: Also rejects the reserved system user name and an e-mail already used by another account (`email already exists`); `recaptcha` and `tutorialDone` are ignored. Returns only `{ok: 1}`.
notes.userBadgeSvg: Renders 128x128 SVG; users without a valid badge get an empty `<svg>`; unknown users get HTTP 404 `text/plain` `Not Found`.
notes.userBranches: Ignores `withCode` and always returns complete branch documents including `user`, `modules` and `timestamp` (Unix milliseconds, absent until code is first saved).
notes.userCloneBranch: Also rejects empty or `$`-prefixed `newName` (`invalid branch name`) and invalid `defaultModules` (`invalid params`). `timestamp` is the cloned branch's timestamp (same Unix-millisecond clock).
notes.userCodeSet: May also answer `invalid params` for malformed requests. Module names `__proto__` are also dropped; `_hash` may be a string or number.
notes.userConsole: Non-string expressions yield `invalid params`. Returns only `{ok: 1}`.
notes.userDecorationsInventory: No hosted decoration economy: always `{ok: 1, list: []}`, and the server advertises no `inventory` feature.
notes.userDecorationsThemes: No hosted decoration economy: always `{ok: 1, list: []}`.
notes.userFind: Answers `user not found` for unknown users or when neither parameter is given, and omits malformed stored badges.
notes.userMemorySegmentGet: Parses `segment` with `parseInt`, so a list reads only its first id and returns a single value.
notes.userMemorySegmentSet: `data` must be a string, number or boolean (`invalid params` otherwise); its string form is stored.
notes.userMemorySet: Rejects invalid paths (empty segments, `__proto__`) with `Incorrect memory path` and, at execution, fails the hidden command when an intermediate path element is not an object. Returns only `{ok: 1}`.
notes.userMessagesIndex: Conversations are keyed by respondent id. Message `date` values are ISO 8601 strings, serialized from the original backend's Date values.
notes.userMessagesList: Message `date` values are ISO 8601 strings, matching the original storage RPC and HTTP JSON serialization.
notes.userMoneyHistory: Numeric log dates are converted to ISO 8601 strings at the wire boundary. Market details also carry `orderId`/`anotherUser`.
notes.userMoneyHistoryDetails: A single world serves the details from its own money ledger (the entries listed by `GET /api/user/money-history`), resolving the counterparties of a market deal by `tick`, `roomName` and `targetRoomName`; the official market history page calls it without an `options.official` branch.
notes.userName: Returns the username of the session token owner (standalone session tokens are always full-access).
notes.userOverview: Returns the single-world flat shape (`rooms`, `stats`, `statsMax`, `totals`, `gametimes`) instead of `shards`. `statName` defaults to `energyHarvested`; unknown intervals yield `invalid params` and a missing interval reads as 8 (1440 uses 7 daily slots).
notes.userPasswordSet: Standalone servers sign players in with username or e-mail plus password (`POST /api/auth/signin`); this operation changes that local password. OpenScreeps revokes the account's tokens and authenticated socket sessions whenever a password changes, so the client must sign in again afterwards.
notes.userRespawn: Also deletes the player's power creep records, records `lastRespawnDate`, and resets only the player's controller rooms to `normal`.
notes.userRooms: Returns the single-world flat shape `{ok: 1, rooms}` sorted by controller level (descending) without `reservations`; `reservation` is ignored. An unknown or missing `id` returns an empty list.
notes.userStats: 1440 uses 7 daily slots. `id` is required (the route is unauthenticated, so there is no caller fallback); unknown or missing users yield `user not found`.
notes.userTutorialDone: Accepts the call and stores nothing.
notes.userWorldStartRoom: Ignores `shard` and returns a plain room name: a random owned-controller room, else `W5N5` if it exists, else the alphabetically first `normal` room.
notes.userWorldStatus: Computed from the single world (no objects → `empty`).

get.description: Returns the shortest of the last 30 measured intervals between completed ticks, in milliseconds. Public and read-only. When `options.official` is false the official room renderer requests it instead of `game/shards/tick`, animates with `max(tick, serverData.socketUpdateThrottle || 200) / 1000` seconds per tick and treats a failure as `tick: 0`.

Room-history chunk endpoint of the private-server protocol. When `options.official` is false the official web client requests `http://<host>:<port>/room-history?room=<room>&time=<tick>` with `time` aligned to `serverData.historyChunkSize`, treats any non-200 status as missing and fills `room` when absent. The body is a history chunk (base tick plus tick-keyed object diffs) without the `ok` envelope.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Base game tick, normally aligned to the advertised historyChunkSize.

404.description: Requested history frame was not retained.

ServerPassword.name: X-Server-Password
ServerPassword.description: Server password of a password-protected private server, independent of player authentication. Required only when the host configures one; a missing or wrong value returns the API error envelope, usually with HTTP 200.
ServerPassword.x-profile-reason: Private-server protocol header: the official client sends it only when `options.official` is false.

Shard.description: Accepted for official-client compatibility. A standalone server serves one world and ignores this value.
Shard.x-profile-reason: Single world: official shard routing does not apply.

AuthSteamAccount.x-profile-reason: The standalone server stores Steam ownership as a single boolean flag and the profile-link visibility as a boolean, and returns an empty object when no Steam account is linked.

ownership.description: Whether the linked Steam account owns the game.

steamProfileLinkHidden.description: Whether the Steam profile link is hidden from other players.

GameCreateInvaderResponse.x-profile-reason: Standalone servers return the inserted invader document with the acknowledgement.

GameCreepBodyPart.x-profile-reason: Standalone-only: body part of the invader document returned by gameCreateInvader.

GameInvaderCreep.x-profile-reason: Standalone-only: invader document returned by gameCreateInvader.

GameMapStatsRoom.description: Per-room map stats. Room-status fields are copied from the room document; `own`, `sign`, `safeMode` and `minerals0` come from room objects; the requested `statName` key (e.g. `energyHarvested8`) holds the ranking for that stat as an array of `{user, value}` sorted by value descending.

GameTickResponse.x-profile-reason: Standalone-only: response of the private-server gameTick addition.

tick.description: Shortest of the last 30 measured tick durations in milliseconds; the configured tick duration until two ticks were observed.

LeaderboardUser.x-profile-reason: The standalone server also includes the listed users' lifetime control points.

MarketMyOrdersResponse.x-profile-reason: Single world: orders are not grouped by shard.
MarketMyOrdersResponse.description: Every order (active or not) owned by the caller as one flat list.

PowerCreepCreateResponse.x-profile-reason: Standalone servers return the created power creep record with the acknowledgement.
PowerCreepCreateResponse.description: `{ok: 1, ...creep}`: a copy of the new record (`level: 0`, `hitsMax: 1000`, `storeCapacity: 100`, `spawnCooldownTime: 0`, `powers: {}`).

UserConsoleQueuedResponse.x-profile-reason: The standalone server returns only `{ok: 1}`; it exposes no database-driver echo.

UserDbWriteResponse.x-profile-reason: The standalone server returns only `{ok: 1}`; it exposes no database-driver metadata.

UserMessagesMarkReadResponse.x-profile-reason: The standalone server returns only `{ok: 1}`; it exposes no internal publish/update results.

UserMoneyHistoryMarketInfo.x-profile-reason: The standalone engine's money-log documents also carry the related order id and counterparty.

UserOverviewFlatResponse.x-profile-reason: A standalone server runs one world, so the overview is returned flat instead of grouped by shard.

ok.description: Success marker; every JSON success body carries `ok: 1`.

rooms.description: Rooms whose controller the user owns, highest level first.

stats.description: Per-room slot values of `statName`, oldest first.

gametimes.description: Highest game tick recorded in each slot, null for empty slots.

UserRoomsFlatResponse.x-profile-reason: A standalone server runs one world, so claimed rooms are returned as a flat list instead of grouped by shard.

ok.description: Success marker; every JSON success body carries `ok: 1`.

rooms.description: Rooms whose controller the user owns, highest controller level first.

UserRoomsFlatResponse.description: Single-world list of claimed rooms (no `shards` grouping).

Token.description: Session token issued by the standalone server (for example by `authSignin` or `authSteamTicket`). Successful authenticated responses may rotate it in the X-Token response header; store the latest value. Never send tokens to untrusted hosts or follow authenticated cross-host redirects.
Token.x-profile-reason: Standalone servers issue their own session tokens instead of screeps.com account tokens.
